local.description: Node-local ordinal, allocated by the owning registry.

ModuleId.description:
Names a Module implementation in the registry, matching
`^[A-Za-z0-9_-]+(\.[A-Za-z0-9_-]+)*$`, at most 256 bytes.

The reverse-DNS-ish namespaced form (`ezsdr.test.provider`) is what keeps two
vendors' Modules from colliding; the Kernel checks the shape, not the authority.

Rule: SB-1, MA-31.

ModuleRef.description: A Module by id and version (MA-31).

NodeId.description:
A node in the (future) multi-host deployment. `LOCAL` is the only legal value in v4.0.

Rule: X7 (`00-overview.md`); it qualifies every id of TM-11, SC-6, SB-3 and MA-38.

Pacing.description:
How a Time Authority paces its primary root; cross-checked against the derived
[`ExecutionClass`] by MA-41 (MA-29, TM-16a1).

oneOf.description: Virtual time advances as fast as the model allows: the Simulation class.

Virtual time is paced against the wall clock: RealtimeEmulation, the class
that exists to expose real deadlines (TM-16a1).
A device timekeeper drives the Run: HardwareInLoop or Hardware.

governs.description:
The domains it advances: a primary root, that root's derived domains,
`host.monotonic`, and for a simulation Authority every root it simulates
(TM-16a, MA-29).

module.description:
The exact Module version this Authority is, which admission compares with its
binding, so a profile hash names one version of the Module that picks the
ExecutionClass (SB-22f, D98).

pacing.description: How it paces its primary root; MA-41 cross-checks it (MA-29).
